_about: Outcomes the owner knows for sure (e.g. the airline never posted the cancellation). These always win over airline status. Format: "date|airport|flight": "Canceled" / "Canceled (not weather)" / "Departed" / "Arrived" / "Diverted". "Canceled (not weather)" = cancelled for an airline reason (crew, maintenance, few bookings): it's labelled and not counted against the forecast.
